svg.title: A Universal Union logical architecture
svg.desc: A conceptual logical architecture with participant-controlled identity on the left, the AUU civic core in the center, and replaceable external systems on the right. Stable civic contracts define actors, authority, standing, visibility, records, process transitions, and recognition. Cross-cutting privacy, accessibility, safety, governance, legal, operational, and anti-capture protections govern every layer.

text.tspan: CONCEPTUAL · NO STACK OR DEPLOYMENT SELECTED
Stable civic meanings at the center; replaceable implementations at the edges.
actor · membership · standing · authority · recognition · visibility
issue · proposal · decision · mandate · delegation · action · challenge · repair
Stable meanings let interfaces, protocols, models, storage, and hosting change without silently changing civic claims.
source links · provenance · explanation / audit · protected review · correction · retention · export
AUU can record authorization and follow-through. People and institutions still act, recognize, and enforce outside the platform.
LOGICAL ARCHITECTURE · NO PRODUCTION SYSTEM EXISTS YET
